description: Formal pipeline eval over the real LangGraph planner, synthesizer, grounding, and critic nodes with deterministic synthetic retrieval fixtures.

results.label: embedding_model_and_dimension
results.answer:
DocChat uses the BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model, and the embeddings are 384-dimensional float32 vectors.

Sources: [PDF — architecture.pdf p.2]

results.label: pdf_ocr_fallback
results.answer:
When a scanned page has no embedded text, DocChat uses pytesseract OCR as a fallback to extract the text before chunking. This is done after an initial attempt to extract text using PyMuPDF, also imported as fitz.

Sources:
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.4]

results.label: pdf_chunking_parameters
results.answer:
PDF ingestion does not directly use a chunk size and overlap, instead, it's the DocChat that splits PDF text with a chunk size of 1500 characters and an overlap of 200 characters.
Sources:
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.5]

results.label: youtube_transcript_library
results.answer:
The youtube-transcript-api library is used to fetch YouTube transcripts. The transcript segments are grouped into chunks of roughly 60 seconds before embedding and storage.
Sources:
[YouTube — DocChat ingestion demo @120s]

results.label: web_ingestion_libraries
results.answer:
Web ingestion uses httpx for sending HTTP requests and trafilatura for extracting article content.

Sources:
[Web — https://docs.example.com/web-ingestion]

results.label: agent_nodes
results.answer:
The LangGraph agent pipeline consists of five nodes: 
1. Planner 
2. Retriever 
3. Synthesizer 
4. Grounding 
5. Critic

Sources: 
[PDF — agent.pdf p.7]

results.label: chat_streaming_transport
results.answer:
YouTube ingestion fetches transcripts with youtube-transcript-api. Transcript segments are grouped into chunks of roughly 60 seconds before embedding and storage. In the demo, chat responses are streamed back to the browser using Server-Sent Events so users can see words arrive incrementally. The technical details of how Server-Sent Events stream chat responses back to the browser are not provided in the given context. 
Sources: [YouTube — DocChat ingestion demo @120s], [YouTube — DocChat chat demo @240s]

results.label: multi_source_ingestion_libraries
results.answer:
For PDF ingestion, the libraries used are PyMuPDF (also imported as fitz) for extracting text and pytesseract OCR as a fallback. For YouTube ingestion, the library used is youtube-transcript-api for fetching transcripts. For web ingestion, the libraries used are httpx for sending HTTP requests and trafilatura for extracting article content.

Sources: 
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.4], [YouTube — DocChat ingestion demo @120s], [Web — https://docs.example.com/web-ingestion]
